grid.width: positive integer matching the generated challenge grid when imported into setup
grid.height: positive integer matching the generated challenge grid when imported into setup

source.label: human-readable source label
source.usesForecast: true by default; fair solver-visible field
source.usesTruth: true only when field includes hidden/actual truth information
source.usesOracle: true for oracle/benchmark data that must not be treated as fair leaderboard input

frames: optional frame array for imported vector fields. Each frame has time/t and vectors/current as height x width entries of {u,v} or [u,v]. Times must be strictly increasing.
syntheticConfig: optional shared currentFieldConfig object with basePreset, fieldMode, evolution behavior/speed, timeMode, cycleDurationHours, frameInterpolation, dynamicComplexity, variation levels, additive layers, and optional topologyComposite region metadata.

boundaryConditions.shoreRiskRadius: cell radius used for land-boundary risk/deflection
boundaryConditions.dampenIntoLand: 0..1 scale for reducing current component into land
boundaryConditions.deflectStrength: 0..1 scale for rotating inward current along shore

metadata.description: human-readable description; synthetic HYCOM-inspired fields are not real HYCOM forecasts

notes: Readable schema-like documentation. Import validation is implemented in src/core/io/FlowFieldImporter.js. Imported flow fields define current behavior only; challenge terrain remains the land/water boundary mask.
